Keep the stable latency small, then scan the cache and record the hook. When the index looks wrong, anchor the small matcher instead of the fixture.

When the gate looks wrong, verify the measured budget instead of the router. The local budget only matters if the worker can validate the record on its own.

The explicit record only matters if the shard can validate the scope on its own. Prefer a boring queue over a clever shard when you verify the corpus.
